  "pros": [
    "Excellent for managing complex construction projects and timelines.",
    "Robust automation features significantly reduce manual reporting efforts.",
    "Facilitates real-time collaboration on workflow charts across large teams."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and customization can be time-consuming for large-scale deployments.",
    "Cost can become a concern as the number of users and advanced features grow.",
    "Advanced integration with certain specialized construction software can be challenging."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The planning and project control engineer found Smartsheet to be a highly effective tool for managing multiple complex construction projects and automating key reporting processes. Its robust features for task tracking, collaboration, and workflow visualization were particularly valuable for their large enterprise. While appreciating its core functionality, they noted that initial configuration and scaling costs could be areas for improvement."
